market_context.benchmark_filter: SPY or QQQ must be above its 50-day SMA for any bullish bias. ETFs are sector/market proxies — if the broad market is broken, skip all ETF longs.

bias_criteria_note: ETFs move slower than individual stocks — fewer false breakouts, but also slower entries. Treat TWB signals as sector rotation confirmation, not just single-stock momentum. Bearish = exit/avoid longs only. No short ETF entries (use inverse ETFs separately if needed).

bullish: ETF printing higher highs and higher lows on the daily
TWB Oscillator shows recent bullish breakout signal
Breakout volume above 10-day average (sector rotation inflow signal)
Price approaching upper Nadaraya-Watson Envelope band but not extended outside it
Sector has a clear macro catalyst (Fed policy, earnings season, sector rotation)
bearish: ETF printing lower highs and lower lows on the daily
Price broken back below prior breakout trendline on above-average volume
Sector rotation out — relative performance vs SPY deteriorating
neutral: ETF consolidating with no clear direction
Price chopping inside NW Envelope bands
Volume at or below average — no sector rotation evident

long: ETF consolidating near highs after a prior move up
TWB Oscillator prints bullish B signal
Volume breakout on the entry candle — confirms sector inflow
Price breaking toward upper NW Envelope band but not outside it

exit_criteria.stop_loss: Below breakout candle low or prior swing low. Exit if price closes back below the broken trendline (failed breakout).
exit_criteria.take_profit_1: Scale out 1/2 to 1/3 at upper Nadaraya-Watson Envelope band.
exit_criteria.take_profit_2: Trail remaining on 9 EMA. Exit if price closes below 9 EMA for 2 consecutive days.

risk_rules: No bullish entries if SPY or QQQ is below its 50-day SMA
ETFs move slower — require more patience on entries, don't chase breakouts
Maximum 2 open ETF positions at once (ETFs are broader — one sector ETF covers 30+ stocks)
Prefer sector ETFs (XLK, SMH, XLE) over thematic (ARTY, CHAT) for cleaner signals
asset_notes: Sector and thematic ETFs on daily timeframe. TWB signals on ETFs represent institutional sector rotation — higher conviction than single stocks because many funds must agree. Screener is sorted by 3M performance so top names are the strongest rotating sectors. Top names typically: SOXX/SMH (semis), XLK/VGT (broad tech), CIBR (cybersecurity), QTUM (quantum/AI), SPMO/MTUM (momentum factor).
